content:
incident-bot: ALERT: paging fired for release/backend-api (canary). Metrics: p99 latency 3.8s (>3s), 5xx rate 4.2% (>1.5%) across canary slice. Trigger: rollout 2026-03-15-87. PagerDuty PD-45912 opened.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired -> oncall rotation (sre-weekend). Incident key PD-45912. Auto-escalation in 8m.

devon: ack — I'm oncall, investigating.

marta: oncall here, joining. @devon drop the canary dashboard link? :eyes:

devon: dashboard https://dash.redwood.internal/canary/release/2026-03-15-87
Looking at canary pods: sustained queue depth increase, tail latency spikes, subset of pods ~10% showing GC thrash + 502/503 bursts.

alice: `rwdctl routes get --release 2026-03-15-87` shows canary weight=15%.

devon: lowering canary weight to 0.5% now via routing API — cutting exposure while we triage.
```bash
rwdctl traffic set --release 2026-03-15-87 --canary-weight 0.5
```

pagerduty-bot: PD-45912 acknowledged by marta.

ben: customer impact: support signals show timeouts for a small % of enterprise customers (acct: acct_93, acct_424). CS has 2 live tickets referencing timeouts. Potential SLA exposure on a tiny cohort.

marta: okay — @support-team please draft a short status note: "We've observed increased latency for some requests after a rollout. Mitigation in progress; we are rolling back the canary. We'll follow up with details." I'll send once we confirm rollback.

devon: initiating rollback to previous revision now.
```bash
rwdctl rollout revert --release 2026-03-15-87 --to=2026-03-14-58
```

incident-bot: Rollback job rb-1234 started. Logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/jobs/rb-1234

alice: routing moved: canary 15% -> 0.5% then -> 0.0. Rollback progressing.

devon: rollback finished, traffic now back to previous revision. Monitoring post-rollback.

alice: metrics trending: p99 3.8s -> 420ms in last 90s, 5xx -> 0.4%. :thumbsup:

marta: holding PD open for a 10m stability window before close. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ben: will prepare the customer-facing status update once we hit stability. Tentative note ready.

devon: initial suspicion: new batching + kv-cache invalidation pattern under moderate traffic produced backpressure on a minority of GPU hosts; kernel/quant path telemetry shows memory pressure and retries causing tail latency. will capture heap dumps and kernel traces from affected hosts.

marta: assigning postmortem owners: devon (RCA lead), alice (telemetry/metrics), ben (customer comms). Please create INF-2026-87, link PD-45912 and rb-1234.

pagerduty-bot: PD-45912 status updated -> mitigated by marta.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated — rollback successful. Handoff to postmortem and infra follow-up. Closing thread after stability window.
